sloka: तां श्रुत्वा दिव्यसङ्काशां कथामद्भुतदर्शनाम् ।लक्ष्मणः परमप्रीतो राघवं वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।। ७.५७.१ ॥
transliteration: tāṁ śrutvā divyasaṅkāśāṁ kathāmadbhutadarśanām ।lakṣmaṇaḥ paramaprīto rāghavaṁ vākyamabravīt ।। 7.57.1 ॥

translations.english: Having heard that divine-like and amazing story, Lakshmana was greatly pleased and spoke these words to Rama.
